other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations like TF-IDF are fit on the entire training dataset prior to cross-validation splits. This leaks information from the validation folds (such as vocabulary and IDF weights) into the training folds, making out-of-fold features slightly biased.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing evaluation reporting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent sets up cross-validation but entirely fails to compute or print any internal validation metric (like RMSE), making it impossible to assess model performance without submitting to an external leaderboard.

summary: The agent demonstrates a generally solid approach, employing out-of-fold stacking for text features alongside robust gradient boosting models for the tabular data. However, it exhibits a naive ensembling strategy for its final predictions and leaks validation data during cross-validation by fitting TF-IDF on the entire training set prior to splitting. Additionally, the agent completely fails to compute or report any validation scores internally.
